verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents delivery to major warehouses (ClickHouse, BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, Postgres) plus 'dozens of SaaS tools' and generic webhook destinations, and supports per-destination filtering/mapping via Functions (filter/transform/enrich, choosing not to connect source→destination) as well as a documented destinations catalog page. However, community feedback from early users noted a 'higher bar to implementation' versus Segment and fewer built-in ad-source integrations, suggesting the destination catalog breadth may lag category leaders even though the mapping/filtering mechanism itself is well documented. Missing for 10: an exhaustive/quantified list of all supported destinations, independent verification of per-destination mapping UI (vs. custom code), and more recent hands-on confirmation matching current catalog size.
